title: LED indicator board
prompt: Design a small printed circuit board: a 2-pin power header feeding an LED through a current-limiting resistor. Board outline at most 30mm × 20mm, 1.6mm FR4, two copper layers. Place at least three components (header, resistor, LED footprints), declare the nets (VCC from header pin 1 through the resistor to the LED anode; LED cathode back to header pin 2 as GND), and route every net so its copper is fully connected. The finished board must pass a design-rule check clean: no clearance violations, no unconnected or split nets, no shorts. Output a .vcad document containing the board as a PcbBoard node.
